name: 나윤희

appearance_en.face_shape: refined oval face, defined moderate cheekbones, clean jaw naturally softened by age — the face television made familiar and familiarity made trustworthy. Looks like someone who has seen everything, which is the most useful thing a face can look like
appearance_en.skin: warm medium-fair Korean skin, naturally luminous — maintained but not concealed. Fine lines at eye corners and nasolabial folds present and unfought. The visible age of a woman whose credibility rests partly on not hiding things
appearance_en.eyes: warm dark double-eyelid eyes, outer corners with natural age droop softened by decades of practiced warmth — the gaze that makes interviewees say things they should not say on record. Rendered in ink as the panel's warmest element, which the reader should distrust
appearance_en.nose: straight well-proportioned nose — photographs well, which matters for someone whose face has been on television for twenty years
appearance_en.mouth: well-shaped medium warm-toned lips, the smile calibrated over twenty years of broadcast — in private panels, the mouth goes still and completely different. The contrast is compositionally the reveal
appearance_en.eyebrows: cleanly shaped brows with soft arch, dark with silver threading — the silver allowed in as a strategy, not a surrender
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: fine smile lines at outer eye corners, small graceful mole at right jaw corner — has appeared on screen for twenty years and become part of the recognisable face. In ink, the mole anchors the jaw
appearance_en.hair: silver-threaded dark jaw-length blunt bob — chosen fifteen years ago, became the signature. The silver was a decision

body.proportions: slim composed frame, long neck, deliberate upright posture — the body whose public presentation has become its private one
body.posture: poised and broadcast-precise — always on, including in panels where she believes she is not
body.body_prompt: 163cm slim composed Korean woman, long neck, broadcast-poised upright posture

default.description: structured midi dress or tailored trousers with elegant blouse in muted intellectual tones — dressed to look like she is not thinking about it, which requires considerable thought
default.wardrobe_prompt: elegant structured midi dress or intellectual-toned blouse with tailored trousers, simple quality jewellery

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: warmth performing accessibility — twenty years of broadcast. In unguarded panels, the warmth does not drop so much as pause. The reader notices before the other characters do
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 52-year-old Korean woman, refined oval face with defined cheekbones, warm dark double-eyelid eyes with natural outer-corner droop and practiced warmth, cleanly arched brows with silver threading, straight well-proportioned nose, well-shaped warm-toned calibrated smile, silver-threaded dark jaw-length blunt bob, small mole at right jaw corner, 163cm slim broadcast-poised frame, warm medium-fair luminous Korean skin with unfought fine lines

style_prompt: masako style illustration, clean precise manga ink lines, warm-cool intellectual screen tone, muted authoritative palette, cinematic Korean drama composition, the warmth that is most dangerous because it is partially real, silver-threaded blunt bob as the signature visual element, the mole at the jaw as the anchor
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, ugly, deformed, extra limbs, western comic, cold, aggressive, young, glamorous, beauty filter, idol look
